We need to use valid functional groups. The list includes "C-C double bonds". So we can use that.

Let's search for templates that break aryl halide and form C-C double bond? Actually we need to form C-C bond (single) but the product has double bond (alkene). The reaction is Heck coupling forming C-C double bond (aryl-alkene). So functional_groups_formed maybe "C-C double bonds". functional_groups_broken maybe "aryl halide". Let's try.


Search with functional_groups_formed ["C-C double bonds"], functional_groups_broken ["aryl halide"].
